basic_info.description: Beautiful Park-Front Home by Spreckels Lake in GG Park. Enjoy a lifestyle of comfort & convenience in this stunning, fully detached home directly across from Spreckels Lake. Start your mornings with a jog, run or bike ride, or wind down w/an evening stroll w/loved ones. Just a short walk to the vibrant Balboa corridor, where neighborhood cafs, restaurants & shops await. Flooded w/natural light from abundant windows, this recently renovated home offers an open-concept layout & generous living spaces. With 5BD/4BA, including 2 primary ensuites, there's room for everyone. The main level welcomes you into a spacious great rm featuring an airy living rm, a chef's kitchen w/professional-grade appliances, sleek cabinetry & a large island perfect for meal prep or casual dining. The expansive dining area flows into a modern glass stairwell leading to the garden level, which includes additional bedrooms & a relaxed family rm that opens to a serene backyard. Equipped w/central A/C, 2-car parking-including a 1-car garage & deep driveway & ample storage, this home checks all the boxes for modern city living. Ideally located near Ocean Beach for surfers, Presidio Park, Baker Beach & top-ranking schools. This is a perfect blend of natural beauty, recreation & urban living.
